description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to appoint Mr. W. V. P. P. Yasarathna as Chief Secretary of the Western Province w.e.f. 05.12.2017
categorisation: This gazette content announces the appointment of a specific individual (Mr. Warakagoda Vidanalage Pradeep Priyankara Yasarathne) to a government position (Chief Secretary of the Western Province). It names the person and provides their basic title but does not include any detailed description of their portfolio responsibilities, subject areas, or duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
